entities.summary: Ethel Frances Butwell Bellamy was an English astronomical computer and seismologist known for her significant contributions to the field of astronomy and seismology. Bellamy collected, measured and updated observations from seismological stations around the world, and served as editor of the International Seismological Summary. In 1928 she was awarded a silver medal by the Pope for her work on understanding the Vatican zone plates.
